description: Inspect, validate, diff or query a JSON or JSONL file in the connected SharePoint library, without opening it: infers its shape with per-field coverage, points at the exact line and column of a syntax error, compares two files structurally, pulls a value out by dotted path. Set `action` to exactly one of: inspect, validate, diff, query. `path` is the file's path in the library, for example data/users.json; `other` is the second file, for diff; `key` is the dotted path, for query, for example 0.name or users.2.email. Built-in samples to try with no files of your own: samples/users.json, samples/users_v2.json (diff it with users.json), samples/events.jsonl, samples/broken.json (validate).

path.description: The file's path in the library, for example data/users.json

other.description: A second file's path, for diff

key.description: A dotted path for query, for example users.0.name
